description: RAG knowledge base manifest for ArchCheck — Singapore & China building code compliance documents. Free texts are ingested; paid standards are indexed as metadata + citation pointers only.

SG.CP 5: Re-designated SS 638:2018 (Code of Practice for Electrical Installations). Update any reference.
SG.SS 551 with emergency lighting: SS 551 is earthing/protection against lightning. Emergency lighting is SS 563.
SG.SS 575 with emergency lighting: SS 575 is fire hydrant systems / hose reels. Emergency lighting is SS 563. (SS 575 used for fire water tank capacity IS correct.)

CN.GB 50045: Replaced by GB 50016-2014. Do NOT cite.
CN.GB 50016 / GB 51309 / GB 50974 / GB 5011: Mandatory clauses repealed by GB 55037-2022 / GB 55036-2022 (eff. 2023-06-01 / 2023-03-01). Keep as detailed design reference only.
CN.GB 55037-2025: Wrong year — actual standard is GB 55037-2022.

CN_Mandatory.label: China — Mandatory General Codes (Priority 0, free full text by law)

documents.name: 建筑防火通用规范
documents.name_en: General Code for Fire Protection of Buildings
documents.authority: 住建部 / 国家市场监管总局
documents.scope: Fully mandatory. Since 2023-06-01 repeals most mandatory clauses of GB 50016 (fire compartment, evacuation, exits, fire lanes), GB 50067, etc.
documents.notes: Downloaded — official gov.cn PDF (66 pages, 65.7 MB). NOT on openstd.samr.gov.cn (that covers 国家标准, not 工程建设规范).

documents.name: 消防设施通用规范
documents.name_en: General Code for Fire Protection Facilities
documents.authority: 住建部 / 国家市场监管总局
documents.scope: Fully mandatory, eff. 2023-03-01. Repeals mandatory clauses of GB 50974-2014, GB 50116-2013, GB 51309-2018, GB 50084-2017, etc.
documents.notes: Downloaded — gov-hosted mirror (达州市, 16.6 MB, 37 sheets); content verified as GB 55036 announcement text. Original: 住建部 公告 2022年第116号.
